close_reason: Added inline comments explaining both fallback branches in ava_values_match
description: The ava_values_match function has two non-obvious fallback paths: (1) when both values fail any_to_str_bytes, it falls back to raw DER byte comparison, and (2) when one is a string type and the other isn't, it returns false. The first is mentioned in any_to_str_bytes comments but not in ava_values_match rustdoc. The second is not documented at all. Clarify when these paths are hit and why (e.g., which string types fall through, whether type mismatches indicate malformed certificates).
title: ava_values_match: document raw DER fallback and type mismatch behavior
